senses.gloss: m. (foreg. wds.) prop. designated to step behind, substitute; hence, he who (or that which) is gone back to, obligated, pledged; surety, guarantor.—Pl. אַחֲרָאִים, אַחֲרָיִין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 3:5">Dem. III, 5</cite> <he>אין אנו א׳ וכ׳</he> we are not responsible for deceivers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 9:9">Pes. IX, 9</cite> <he>אינן אחראין זה לזה</he> they are not responsible to one another (need not care for each other).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 8:5:2">Y. Keth. VIII, end, 32ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל נכסיו א׳</he> all his landed property is pledged for &c.
